embeds.title: BLHA COMMISSIONER SUPPORT
embeds.description: Open a private ticket for anything that shouldn't be handled in public.

fields.name: USE THIS ROOM FOR
fields.value: Disputes • Complaints • Payment questions • Roster or platform problems

fields.name: TIMING
fields.value: A request to review a material Commissioner ruling must be made within 48 hours of the ruling (Article XIX).

fields.name: PRIVACY
fields.value: Never post passwords, payment credentials or account numbers.
